errors.text_span: Finally, the 'Signal Layer' corresponds to three medium blue outer slices: 'Acoustic Quality Analysis,' 'AnomalyDetection,' and a very thin slice labeled 'Audio Difference Analysis.'
errors.evidence: The 'Signal Layer' in the inner ring corresponds to only two outer slices: 'Acoustic Quality Analysis' and 'Anomaly Detection'. The slice for 'Audio Difference Analysis' is visually separate, located at the top of the chart, has a different color (dark grey), and is not part of the 'Signal Layer' group. The description incorrectly states there are three slices and wrongly includes 'Audio Difference Analysis' in this group.

The description uses inconsistent color naming. The 'Signal Layer' and its corresponding outer slices are the same color as the 'Semantic Layer' slices, but the former are described as 'medium blue' while the latter are described as 'light blue-grey'.
